description: TRE ALTAMIRA InSAR Subsidence Data is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Department of Water Resources. This dataset represents measurements of vertical ground surface displacement in more than 200 of the high-use and populated groundwater basins across the State of California between January of 2015 and April of 2022.
